title: api-config-client-schema-sketch-jamie
content:
SCRATCHPAD: client-side config + API shape for inference requests

Goals:
- Single request shape that supports streaming, function-calls, and structured outputs
- Keep client config minimal; server-side routing/policy handles complexity
- Allow per-request hints: preferred_model, latency_slo_ms, cost_tier

PROPOSED SHAPE (rough):
{
  "schema_version": "v1",
  "request_id": "<uuid>",
  "model_hint": "redwood/opensft-7b:v2",
  "mode": "chat|completion|embed",
  "input": { "type": "text|messages|blob", "value": "..." },
  "stream": true,
  "callables": ["tool_name"],
  "metadata": {"user_id":"...","session":"..."},
  "policy": {"latency_slo_ms":300, "cost_tier": "balanced"}
}

Notes:
- "input" should be flexible: if messages array, preserve role/metadata. If text, convert server-side to messages for chat models.
- "policy" is advisory; server may override when capacity/SLAs differ.
- Consider "client_capabilities" to signal streaming + partial responses handling (e.g., supports-deltas:true)

Architecture sketch (text):
client -> edge-gateway (auth, rate-limit) -> request-router (model_hint routing & policy) -> runtime-pool -> model-instance
                                     \-> cache-checkpoint (prefix KV cache)

Open questions:
- Naming: "model_hint" vs "model_selector"? prefer "hint" to allow fallback variants.
- How to version schema? top-level "schema_version": "v1" needed.
- Function/tool calling payload format — reuse existing tool spec? keep small

Action items:
- Sync with Evan on server routing fallbacks (Evan: assign action INFR-4321)
- Add schema_version and formalize in Confluence page (see linked_artifacts)
- Quick prototype in SDK: JS + Python to validate ergonomics

References / links: see linked artifacts; Slack thread #dev-client-api (recent discussion)

Notes-to-self: keep shape forgiving; server should normalize. Will iterate after prototyping JS SDK.
